title: Primus Monthly Engineering Report — 2026-11
key_findings: Continuity-based window 2026-10-01 17:02 GMT+8 -> 2026-11-01 17:02 GMT+8 (~31 days). gap_detected = true because window_start (2026-10-01) is earlier than the first day of the current calendar month (2026-11-01), so this run backfills late-October activity a plain calendar-month window would have dropped. All prior weekly+monthly report windows merge into one contiguous coverage group (no >7-day gap), and the span is within the healthy monthly range (<45 days).

80 PRs merged to main in the window. Largest categories: Other 24 (Primus Projection backends, SpecForge, new model/recipe work for GLM-5.3, ZAYA1, Inkling, MI455X, AutoModel diffusion), Bug Fix 22, Performance Optimization 16, CI/Infra 8, Turbo/Dependency Version Update 6, Docs 3, Refactor 1.

The tree diff is 2722 files / 531548 insertions / 293033 deletions; the release tag carries 28 release-only commits not on main. Recommendation: plan sync.

No TorchTitan backend-gap regeneration (pin did not move). Recommendation: plan sync.

Turbo work landing this quarter underpins several in-window Primus PRs: Mega MoE memory sized to dispatched rows (#1271, Turbo #566/#568), GPT-OSS on MegaMoE with expert biases (#1285), FlyDSL kernels ported to the 0.3.x API (#1275), and tensorwise-FP8 Qwen3-30B-A3B on MI355X (#1247).
